Gossip tile context, ping request and update types, and signature helper functions.

# Purpose
This header defines the data types and public interface used by a gossip tile in the `discof` gossip system. It declares `fd_gossip_tile_ctx_t`, which stores the tile state, including gossip state, contact information, input and output channel contexts, keyguard and keyswitch access, timing data, and random number state. It also provides inline helper functions to build and decode a packed gossip signature with [`fd_gossvf_sig`](<#fd_gossvf_sig>), [`fd_gossvf_sig_addr`](<#fd_gossvf_sig_addr>), [`fd_gossvf_sig_port`](<#fd_gossvf_sig_port>), and [`fd_gossvf_sig_kind`](<#fd_gossvf_sig_kind>), and it defines small message types for ping requests and ping updates. The file ends by declaring the external tile runner `fd_tile_gossip`, which connects this interface to the topology runtime.
